title: QoL Builder
description: A modpack for Minecraft that focuses on building and quality-of-life enhancements, intended to make creative building easier, quicker, and more pleasurable.
body:
I always thought that there are too few QoL modpacks in Minecraft in general, and since I love building in Minecraft, I decided to take matters into my own hands and create this modpack.
This modpack is for people who want to build projects or try out new things in creative without having to search for mods that make life easier and are compatible with each other.

This modpack includes content from other creators.
All rights belong to the original authors.
